text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

Reps got back about five hours a week, and CRM updates stopped being a Friday-night chore.

Notes improved, not just sped up. Next steps and budget signals were captured consistently, so handoffs to solutions engineers got smoother.

Trust took work. Some customers hesitated until reps asked consent upfront and explained how data was used.

Adoption followed managers. Teams whose leads reviewed summaries in pipeline calls stuck with it; others faded by week six.

Accuracy slipped in noisy plants and trade shows, so we kept manual notes there.

Our takeaway: treat it as a coaching tool first, a time-saver second.

What would you test?
